stem: In the circle with center \(O\), what is the length of minor arc \(AB\)?
solution: The central angle is \(60^{\circ}\), which is \(\frac{60}{360} = \frac{1}{6}\) of the circle.

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{60}{360} \cdot 2\pi(18)\); it doubles the radius, using 18 as if it were the radius.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{60}{360} \cdot \pi(9)^{2}\), the area of the sector, not the arc length.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(2\pi(9)\), the circumference of the whole circle.

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert d('O','A')==9 and abs(d('O','B')-9)<0.01 and abs(ang('A','O','B')-60)<0.1
ans=2*pi*9*Rational(60,360)
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0 and ans==3*pi
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
